INV_DEFAULT_SELECT: Information notes, select an item to learn about it.
INV_UNKNOWN_ITEM: Unknown item. They say it is lost in the corners of this kingdom.
ITEM_WEAPON_DESC: A sharp blade forged at the foot of the castle. Press J to clear the path through the thicket and defend yourself against intruders.
ITEM_GLIDE_DESC: Old fabric found in the storage, so soft and light it makes you fly. Hold LSHIFT in mid-air to glide smoothly.
ITEM_DASH_DESC: Magic amulet that allows you to travel short distances at high speed to dodge attacks and cross impossible areas. Press K to use it.
ITEM_WALLJUMP_DESC: A strange amulet that allows you to cling to walls and jump from them to reach inaccessible places. Press L to grab on.
ITEM_DOUBLEJUMP_DESC: Amulet used to propel yourself a second time in mid-air, allowing you to reach new heights. Use SPACE in mid-air.
ITEM_KEY_CASTLE_DESC: A sturdy key from the cleaning staff. It unlocks the royal storage door, what could they be keeping there?
ITEM_KEY_CASTLEDOOR_DESC: A large key capable of opening the main castle door, guarded by General Roc of the army.
ITEM_KEY_FOREST_DESC: A moss-covered key, they say it grants access to the depths of the forest.
ITEM_KEY_MOUNTAIN_DESC: Forged with dragon scales. It will allow you to open the path to the main mountain cave.
ITEM_KEY_CATACOMBS_DESC: Forged in stone and minerals. Unlocks the heavy doors to the underground darkness.
